I recently tried out the Nudestix Lemon-Aid Detox & Glow Micro-Peel and felt compelled to share my thoughts. In a world swamped with skincare products promising miracles it's a breath of fresh air to find something that actually leans into its natural ethos.First off let's talk about the texture. This micro-peel has a surprisingly lightweight feel which is a huge plus for me. I'm not a fan of heavy or sticky products on my skin so this was a pleasant surprise. It's easy to apply and doesn't leave any uncomfortable residue.The lemony scent is another win. It's refreshing without being overpowering a little citrusy pick-me-up during my evening skincare routine. For those sensitive to fragrances though this might be something to consider.Now the main event: the results. I noticed my skin looked visibly brighter and felt smoother after a few uses. The product claims to detoxify and glow-up your skin and it does deliver on that front. It's not an overnight miracle worker but with consistent use the results are evident.However it's not all sunshine and citrus. If you have particularly sensitive skin you might want to patch test first. The peeling action is gentle but can be a bit much for some skin types.In conclusion the Nudestix Lemon-Aid Detox & Glow Micro-Peel is a solid choice for anyone looking to brighten and smooth their skin with a product that feels and smells good. It's a straightforward no-fuss addition to any skincare routine especially if you're after that radiant glo

I was pleasantly surprised that this product actually helped my skin even going through a tough acneic phase as of late. The peel provides just enough mechanical exfoliation where I didn't feel it was irritating my skin even though I'm on retinols and benzyl peroxide right now. I appreciate that there's no overpowering scent and it leaves a more matte finish to the skin and not this overly discoball effect. When I use it in the morning it really helps my makeup glide on smoothly almost like there's no textural differences to it right now. For the price point it would be nice to get a little more product in the tube and also a flip top cap to make it easier in the shower once you squeeze the product out.

The product is extremely easy to use but balls up and falls off your face constantly while you rub it in. I have very dry skin with some extremely dry patches and definitely noticed a difference in those areas. It didn't remove the dead skin entirely which was a little frustrating but the difference was appreciated. The lemon scent was light and fresh and the packaging was easy to use. I have tried two similar products in the past; one was monumentally more expensive and I would say it removed the same amount of dead skin but did not leave my skin as soft afterward. The other costs considerably less for more product and does an amazing job at removing dead skin. They recently raised the price of it but it's still costs less of the three. I will say that the NudeStix does make the skin feel softer after use than all three however. This product is gentle enough to use everyday but because of the price point I would probably save it for special occasions or for when skin needs a little more help.

This is a peeling gel. It is supposed to ball up when you rub it on your skin. It creates a gentle physical exfoliation that is less abrasive than other physical exfoliators (like nuts or sugar). It is also less harsh than a chemical peel. I've used many peeling gels over the years and this one is pretty nice. It can be a little messy so I like to use it in the shower. There isn't any strong perfumes or fragrances which is also nice. This isn't meant to be a strong chemical peel but a gentle physical one that you can use several times a week. If you have some very troublesome flaky skin you might need something stronger. But for regular skin care I find this does the trick without damaging my sensitive skin.

This product wasn't what I was expecting. I felt as though the product should have been thicker and have more exfoliant inside it. It did leave my face feeling refreshed and slightly exfoliated but I think there are better products on the market. I enjoyed the very slight lemon scent. In fact I feel as though it could be more scented. It was barely noticeable. The lack of scent however might be a strong point for others with scent sensitivities or no scent preferences. The packaging is cute. I enjoy the bright tube and the font/style. The price to me is definitely not worth the cost of the product however so this is something I am glad I got to try for reviewing purposes.

avis.titre: Gently Cleanses Pores While Brightening the Skin
avis.texte: As far as peels go the NUDESKIN Lemon-Aid Detox & Glow Micro-Peel is a suitable option for those with sensitive skin. It doesn't feel particularly abrasive and can be used on a weekly basis. This product both cleanses and brightens and it does not feel harsh on the face (although you can feel a slight grittiness when massaging into the skin). There is a slight scent of citrus but I didn't smell it too much when applying it to my face. I did find the pilling to be a bit of a surprise but it washed away without issue. In terms of extraction I observed a slight reduction of sebum around the sides of my nose but as with many products continuous usage yields stronger results over time. I did notice the skin had a subtle glass skin effect so there is no residue left behind.
Really good product scent isn't overpowering. Skin feels very soft afterwards and not irritating at all. Can get a bit messy since the product pills and falls off your face.

I am so happy I had the opportunity to try nude sticks glow micro peel as I had excellent results. My skin is prone to breakouts and is very dry and this product has been amazing. I've been using it for a few weeks now and my skin is so much more hydrated and I have one had one break out yet. I use it two to three times a week as directed and I absolutely love the feeling when I take off the mask. My face feels so clean and refreshed and looks so much younger. My skin is much firmer and my husband noticed that the color of my skin is not so dull. The product has a very nice smell that is not too strong and very subtle and pleasant. I highly recommend giving this product a try as it's done wonders for my skin.

avis.titre: When Life Gives You Lemons: A Review of Nudestix Lemon Aid
avis.texte: The Nudestix Lemon Aid Detox and Glow Micro Peel is a facial product that promises to detoxify and brighten your skin. With an attractive packaging and refreshing citrus scent it certainly starts off on the right foot. Yet the texture can be a bit surprising - it's less of a peel or mask and more akin to a damp facial wash reminiscent of water-soaked toilet paper.As a 47-year-old woman with hyperpigmentation and slightly dry skin I found that this product did provide some benefits despite its unconventional texture.Pros:Scent: The aroma of freshly squeezed lemons is invigorating and delightful. It offers a sensory experience that is refreshing.Packaging: The product comes in aesthetically pleasing packaging adding a touch of luxury to your skincare routine.Effectiveness: Despite its textural shortcomings it does leave your skin feeling softer and looking brighter. It seems to help with hyperpigmentation and dry skin to some extent.Cons:Texture: The biggest drawback is the product's texture. It feels like spreading wet toilet paper on your face which is not exactly the spa-like treatment one might hope for.Misleading Name: The name suggests a peel or mask but the consistency and application are more in line with a facial wash.Best Uses:This product can be a good addition to your skincare routine if you prioritize scent and brightness over texture. avis.titre: Invigorating Peel with a Spa-Like Scent
avis.texte: The peel's spa-like fragrance is delightful and inoffensive. Upon application the visible and tactile experience of dry skin flakes being lifted away is satisfying. Despite the positive effects the pricing leaves me unsure about repurchasing. Overall a likable product though not a Holy Grail item for me.
